title: LFHS announces new social studies teacher Robyn Kubik
text:
Robyn Kubik, Lake Forest High School teacher | Lake Forest Community High School D115 Facebook
Robyn Kubik, Lake Forest High School teacher | Lake Forest Community High School D115 Facebook
Lake Forest Community High School District 115 has announced the addition of Robyn Kubik as a new social studies teacher at Lake Forest High School. Kubik was attracted to the school due to its collaborative leadership, strong community ties, and academic reputation. She expressed enthusiasm about contributing to the social studies department and growing with her colleagues. Outside of her professional role, Kubik enjoys spending time with her family and engaging in various recreational activities.
"I was immediately impressed by LFHS's collaborative leadership and warm community," said Kubik. "The support from colleagues and mentors has reinforced my excitement to join, and I look forward to contributing to the Social Studies Department while continuing to grow as an educator."
Lake Forest High School, established in 1935, is a public secondary institution located in Lake Forest, Illinois, serving students from grades 9 through 12. According to Lake Forest Schools, approximately 95% of its students pursue higher education. The school emphasizes mutual respect, high expectations, and a sense of belonging among its student body.

According to Lake Forest Schools, District 115 serves around 1,500 students from Lake Forest, Lake Bluff, and Knollwood. The district offers diverse academic programs including advanced placement courses and specialized electives. Students also have access to athletics, performing arts, and various clubs. Feeder schools include Deer Path Middle School and Lake Bluff Middle School.
